title: Warm Spicy Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty Irish lamb stew with a velvety texture, served solo for a satisfying dinner. This dish combines flavors of Ireland with the warmth of spices.
instructions: Season the lamb cubes with salt and black pepper.
In a large robata grill or Dutch oven, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the grill and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the grill and sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the grill and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, red chili flakes, and dried thyme to the grill and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb cubes back to the grill and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Add the flour to the grill and stir to combine with the lamb and vegetables.
Gradually add the whole milk to the grill, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook, covered, over low heat for 1 hour, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
